'''Puko Naga'''<ref name="Sabritas">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (Sabritas card game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' (Sabritas card game)]]</ref> was a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CWT">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=(Toys"R"Us Exclusive) Nikto Guard|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWexNiktoGuard.asp}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Puko Naga along with another guard greeted and accompanied [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] into [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] so he could negotiate with Jabba an agreement between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="CWF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PukoNaga-Hasbro.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Puko Naga wearing the standard guard uniform as well as a helmet.]]
Puko Naga was first identified in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (Sabritas card game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' card game]] from [[Wikipedia:Mexico|Mexican]] chips producer [[Wikipedia:Sabritas|Sabritas]].<ref name="Sabritas" /> His<ref name="CWT" /> game statistics are roughly average in both attack and defense.<ref name="Sabritas" /> The Puko Naga's action figure from [[Hasbro]] comes with a game card to allow players to pit him against other figures in the line. Naga's game statistics make him poor in use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and in leadership, but fair in battle skills, intelligence, mechanical skills, and luck.<ref name="CWT" />

A [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] guard of Jabba's, similar in appearance with Puko Naga, was located at the Hutt's palace during the Clone Wars. The guard informed Jabba's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[TC-70/Legends|TC-70]], that the four [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] sent out by Jabba to find his abducted son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], had returned, albeit decapitated.<ref name="CWF" />
